short_description: Rosetta OSIRIS imaging system, wide-angle camera (WAC) filters

"Prior to any commercial use by the User of any Data or Data Product, including any use or application that directly or indirectly generates a financial gain, a detailed request for authorisation/licence shall be made by the User"
licence.scope: Level 2, ESA ESDC terms (Space Science Archives; Rosetta data are archived in the ESA Planetary Science Archive), class attribution as for GAIA__GAIA: CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO, non-commercial reuse with the mission credit line; commercial use needs ESA authorisation. The statement covers archive data products; the OSIRIS wide-angle filter curves are SVO records whose profile reference is Magrin et al. 2015, A&A 574, A123 (bibcode 2015A&A...574A.123M); no SVO page link is in info.json (empty). New research, no sibling. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
